Viewers tune in to watch a live auction show that turns out to be nothing more than con artists selling fake art.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E8 — Loan Scam: Money for Nothing; Hawaiian Punched: Fraud in Paradise
A sting operation brings down a Denver businessman; a charismatic con man uses the promise of huge returns to put $30 million in his own pocket.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E13 — The Wizard of Sarasota
Arthur Nadel conjures up a huge hedge fund. Then he disappears and leaves clients without their life savings. Get the inside story on a multi-million-dollar Ponzi scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E7 — The Bling Ring; The Fraudster, the Ex-Stripper and the Missing Millions
A group of wannabe-celebs make off with millions from Hollywood's rich and famous.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E10 — The Accused Crypto Couple
Heather Morgan transforms herself into a business owner, journalist and fledgling rap artist known as Razzlekhan; she and her husband stand accused of laundering $4.5 billion worth of stolen bitcoin, breaking a government record.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E1 — Bound for Murder
Fontainebleau Miami Beach hotel heir Ben Novack Jr. is bludgeoned to death three months after his mother, Bernice, is found dead under suspicious circumstances; Novack's wife, Narcy, a former stripper, becomes the key to unlocking this sordid case.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E2 — The Dungeon Master
Wealthy suburbanite Jane Bashara is found strangled to death in a seedy part of Detroit known for drugs, crime and murder; a handyman is charged, but that's only the beginning of the story which is ultimately about sex, lies and betrayal.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E3 — A Glittering Murder
Living a golden life, entrepreneurs James and Pamela Fayed turn a fledgling coin company into a gold trading empire; after Pamela is brutally stabbed to death, her murder case reveals a federal fraud investigation and a marriage filled with lies.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E9 — Kevin Trudeau's Secrets; Remington Steal
When the FTC fines Infomercial kingpin Kevin Trudeau $37.6 million for all of his get-rich-quick schemes, he claims he's flat broke; Remington Financial Group's "advance fee" scam has cost small business owners their dreams and millions of dollars.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E2 — The Playboy of Indiana
A man with a multimillion-dollar yacht, 80 sports cars and a Playboy magazine model girlfriend runs a $200 million fraud.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E1 — Predatory Behavior
To their victims, they were epitome of terror and the face of their nightmares; five of the most notorious inmates to ever appear on Lockup reveal startling insights into their shocking brands of predatory behavior.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E5 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Rodrick, Morris
More than three thousand kids pass through the juvenile courts in Lake County, Indiana each year; here, consequences can range from a sleepless night in detention to the ultimate punishment for kids who keep coming back: Boys' School.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E1 — A Young People's Guide to Jail
An exploration of first-time inmates that look like they should be sitting in classrooms rather than jail cells.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Piece of Cake
An inmate with a record dating back to age 14 comes to terms with his past and present; another inmate is left cut and bleeding after he is caught off guard during a vicious assault inside the Kent County Jail.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Outcast
Behind the circular walls of Kent County Jail an inmate tries to leave jail the hard way; a female inmate convicted of her fifth drunken driving charge could lose everything; an outcast inmate makes a comment that sparks both violence and panic.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Snitch-innati
A jail shakedown recovers a huge stash of contraband; a young couple is charged with robbery and murder, but as judgment day approaches, one of their lives might depend on the choices of another.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E3 — Raffaello Follieri
An Italian real estate developer romances a Hollywood starlet and misappropriates investor funds.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S1 E5 — Phony Phone Calls; Heavy Metal Fraud
A man is accused of bilking $37 million from thousands of investors by selling investments in payphones that don't exist; a recently paroled telemarketer solicits investments in precious metals.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S1 E6 — Farhad "Fred" Monem: The 'Prison' Escape; Harold Rangel: Living the American Scheme
A former food services administrator is accused of taking bribes; a man and his son target people facing foreclosure.
